newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Ronson Corp Q2 net decreases.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Ronson Corp Q2 net decreases.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Net income for the second quarter of 1997 and 1996 included deferred income tax benefits of $49,000 and $112,000, respectively, and net income for the first six months of 1997 and 1996 included deferred income tax benefits of $99,000 and $224,000, respectively, all as the result of the reduction in the valuation allowance related to deferred income tax assets.
The company paid preferred dividends of $9,000 and $44,000 in the second quarters of 1997 and 1996, respectively, and $18,000 and $88,000 in the first six months of 1997 and 1996, respectively.

The company said that during the first six months of 1997 it accepted approximately 662,000 preferred shares tendered in accordance with its November 1996 Exchange Offer. Approximately 1,125,000 shares were issued in exchange for the preferred shares tendered.

Earnings per share primary assumes the provision for the preferred dividends and earnings per share diluted does not assume the provision for the preferred dividends because the conversion was anti-dilutive.
Net income was calculated before the payment of preferred dividends; earnings per share were calculated after the payment of preferred dividends.
